responses.evidence: Falsifier holds against current wiring: pipeline-run ensureTrustedSurfaceDecision passes cfg.trusted_surface.extra_paths from resolveConfig on the candidate worktree (core/scripts/pipeline-run.ts ~1276–1302; trusted-surface.ts classifyPaths/globsForClass use that list). Base-declared extras are not loaded. A candidate that deletes trusted_surface.extra_paths from .github/pipeline.yml and weakens a previously covered local gate/rubric can classify as passthrough. d1 revised: classification extras are resolved from base_ref repo_policy (union built-ins + base extras + optional candidate-only additive extras); candidate deletion cannot shrink coverage. Required regression: base extras cover a local path, candidate removes extras and weakens that path → rebound or blocked.

Falsifier holds: hashEnginePin (trusted-surface.ts) digests only version, templates_fingerprint, optional root, optional commit_sha. engine-identity resolvePinnedEngineIdentity likewise omits a content hash of judging engine_core modules (only package.json version + templatesFingerprint + optional git commit). Editing installed core/scripts/*.ts without version/template/commit change leaves effective_verifier_hash unchanged. d3 revised: TrustedEnginePin requires modules_fingerprint (process-start content digest of installed engine_core judging modules, same pattern as templates_fingerprint); hashEnginePin includes it; missing modules_fingerprint fails closed on readiness like missing templates_fingerprint; mid-run probe re-hash can drift-invalidate. Residual: already-imported module memory vs disk until process restart is handled by fail-closed invalidation on disk probe change, not by claiming in-memory rebind without restart.

Falsifier holds: rebound today records hashes and allowsReadyToDeploy(true) while resolveConfig still reads worktree .github/pipeline.yml and gate stages execute candidate-side commands/scripts; ensureTrustedSurfaceDecision does not rebind loaders. Prior d5 required (a) load-from-trusted or (b) digest-gate but left class→loader map unspecified. d5 revised with explicit v1 CLASS_LIVE_ENFORCEMENT map for every base_ref and installed_engine class (repo_policy→base config resolution or digest gate; gate_commands→trusted command identity + referenced script bytes; evidence_schemas/eval_rubrics/ownership_authority→base or engine pin loaders; engine_*→process pin). Newly base-absent sensitive files rebound to engine_default/absence and MUST NOT become live acceptance authority. End-to-end injectable fixtures required per class proving candidate-weakened bytes cannot reach readiness.

Falsifier holds: computeTrustedSurfaceDecision untouched base_ref branch sets trustedHash = engineDefaultHash(classId) for all untouched classes (trusted-surface.ts ~484–500), so concrete base .github/pipeline.yml content does not enter effective_verifier_hash on product-only passthrough even though resolveConfig always loads it when present. d6 revised: engine-defined ALWAYS_CONSULTED_VERIFIER_PATHS and CONDITIONAL_CONSULT_RULES constants. Always: installed engine pin (including modules_fingerprint); base blobs for .github/pipeline.yml|.yaml when present at base_sha (repo_policy). Conditional: enabled test/eval/visual/shipcheck gate command strings and referenced script paths from trusted policy; eval/visual/shipcheck rubric paths when those gates enabled; evidence schema modules for families in resolveRequiredEvidenceKinds; ownership/authority maps when override/authority resolution runs. engineDefaultHash only for true absence or documented not-on-path. Tests: matrix changing each always-consulted base blob alters effective_verifier_hash (or blocks) with product-only candidate_paths.

Falsifier holds: checkEngineDrift on effectiveVerifierHashChanged only console.warns (pipeline-run.ts ~1354–1370); no durable invalidation artifact, no affected-family mapping, no readiness refuse until regeneration. ensureTrustedSurfaceDecision early-returns when candidate_sha unchanged, so identity drift without HEAD advance does not re-pin or invalidate evidence. d5 revised mid-run section: durable verifier_invalidation (or equivalent run-store marker) with previous_hash, next_hash, stage, at, affected_evidence_families; class→family map; readiness composition treats prior verifier_fingerprint-bound evidence as non-current; finalize refuses ready-to-deploy while invalidation is open without replacement evidence under the new identity. Fault-injection regression required.

assumptions: The running installed engine is a higher-trust authority than candidate worktree content for defining which paths are sensitive.
Repositories may need extra globs for local rubric/gate layout without redefining built-in classes.
Base-ref .github/pipeline.yml is readable whenever base_sha is available for readiness-relevant runs that may use extras.
invariants: path_class_schema_version starts at 1 and includes engine_core, engine_prompts, repo_policy, gate_commands, evidence_schemas, eval_rubrics, ownership_authority.
Repository config accepts only additive trusted_surface.extra_paths under a strict Zod object; disable/shrink keys are rejected.
Built-in globs live in engine code; candidate content cannot redefine class membership for the decision.

Effective classification globs for a run = BUILTIN_CLASS_GLOBS ∪ extra_paths from base_ref repo_policy pipeline.yml (when base readable) ∪ optional candidate-declared extra_paths applied only as set-union (never set-minus).
Deleting or omitting base-declared extras on the candidate MUST NOT remove those globs from classification for that candidate.

If base_sha/base reader is required to load base extras and is unavailable while the candidate changed repo_policy or any path that would only match via unknown extras, fail closed (blocked) rather than classify under candidate-shrunk coverage alone.
Tests MUST prove: base declares extra_paths covering a local gate/rubric; candidate removes that declaration and weakens the covered file → outcome rebound or blocked, not passthrough.
evidence: Pre-revise gap: ensureTrustedSurfaceDecision uses cfg.trusted_surface?.extra_paths from candidate resolveConfig only.

Does not detect semantic sensitivity outside glob match. Does not treat candidate-only extra_paths as a way to shrink builtins.
decisions.uncertainty: Low on the base-union rule after revision. Residual: if base pipeline.yml is malformed for extras parse, implementation must fail closed or fall back to builtins-only with an explicit reason — not candidate extras alone when base declared coverage.

alternatives.rejected_because: Direct self-judging under a weakened surface.

alternatives.rejected_because: Judging-relevant engine_core source can change under a fixed version/template/commit identity (dirty install or unbumped modules); effective verifier would not move (challenge 3143e32d).

assumptions: Installed engine pin (version + templates_fingerprint + modules_fingerprint [+ root/commit]) is available for readiness-relevant runs.
Integration base SHA is obtainable for base_ref classes when the candidate touches those classes or always-consulted base paths are hashed.
Absence at base is a defined trusted state (engine_default), not an invitation to use candidate-only bytes.
Engine modules and prompt templates for the judging process are loaded from process-local paths (import.meta.url), not from the product candidate worktree under evaluation.
invariants: engine_core and engine_prompts trusted hashes come only from hashEnginePin; never from candidate tree bytes.

TrustedEnginePin MUST include version, templates_fingerprint, and modules_fingerprint (process-start content digest of installed engine judging modules under the engine-defined engine_core path set relative to the install root). root and commit_sha remain optional metadata.

modules_fingerprint is computed like templatesFingerprint: sorted path → sha256(content) over the installed engine_core module set at process start (and re-probed on stage boundaries for drift). It is not optional on readiness-relevant pins.
hashEnginePin digests at least version, templates_fingerprint, and modules_fingerprint (plus root/commit when present).

If engine_pin lacks version, templates_fingerprint, or modules_fingerprint, engine classes status=failed with failure_reason missing_engine_pin (or missing_modules_fingerprint) and aggregate outcome blocked.
Touched base_ref classes hash base blobs via injectable read_base_content; missing base SHA/reader/unreadable base → failed class → blocked.
All touched paths absent at base → engineDefaultHash(classId) as trusted pin for that class’s absence state.
Harness prose / model JSON cannot supply trusted revisions (pure function over injectable inputs only).
Prompt builders use the process-init template snapshot (prompts/index.ts); mid-run candidate edits under worktree prompts/ do not replace that snapshot for the running process.
Tests MUST show: changing installed engine_core module bytes without changing version or templates_fingerprint changes hashEnginePin / effective_verifier_hash (or blocks readiness).

decisions.generalization_boundary: Does not pin arbitrary transitive dependencies of gate scripts. Does not resolve multi-base merge-queue rebases beyond the single base_sha input. engine_default for absent paths is a class-level sentinel digest, not a dump of engine-shipped default file bodies. Does not claim OS sandbox against running a binary copied from the candidate tree — process pin attributes that execution root (#762). In-memory already-imported modules may lag disk until process restart; disk probe drift fail-closes readiness evidence rather than silently re-executing new disk code in the same process.
decisions.uncertainty: Low once modules_fingerprint is required in the pin. Residual: exact module path set (full engine_core globs vs documented judging subset) must be engine-enumerated and tested; too-narrow a set reopens the falsifier.

alternatives.rejected_because: Candidate can still change live .github/pipeline.yml / gates used by resolveConfig and stage gates while outcome=rebound and readiness still advances; fails issue and rebound scenario SHALL use trusted policy surface.

assumptions: Engine classes are process-bound (d3): live prompts/modules come from installed process pin + modules_fingerprint.
Repo base_ref classes that affect acceptance need an explicit rebind of live inputs or a digest gate.
Fingerprint binding remains necessary but not sufficient.
Evidence families align with resolveRequiredEvidenceKinds (review, tester, eval, visual, shipcheck) plus policy-bound residual/override paths.
invariants: Every stage iteration on readiness-relevant runs calls ensureTrustedSurfaceDecision after engine drift check; SHA-stable early-return MUST still re-check engine modules/templates probe and open invalidation state.
blocked decisions refuse deploy_ready finalize when a decision record is present (and when d7 requires a decision).
When trustedSurface is present and blocked or lacks usable hash, resolveVerifierFingerprint returns null.
When trustedSurface is present and resolvable, verifier_fingerprint equals effective_verifier_hash (or pure family-local refinement).

v1 CLASS_LIVE_ENFORCEMENT (explicit class→loader/execution map): (1) engine_core → process modules via import.meta.url + modules_fingerprint digest gate; (2) engine_prompts → prompts/index.ts process-init snapshot + templates_fingerprint; (3) repo_policy → load acceptance-relevant policy from base_sha blob(s) for .github/pipeline.yml|.yaml (and documented includes) OR compare digest of live resolved policy material to class trusted_content_hash and fail closed on mismatch; (4) gate_commands → for each enabled gate in the trusted policy, command identity and referenced script path bytes are loaded from base_sha (or engine default when absent) OR live bytes digest-gated to trusted_content_hash before the gate may authorize readiness; (5) evidence_schemas → readiness producers use engine-shipped and/or base_ref schema modules bound in the decision, not candidate-only weakened schemas; (6) eval_rubrics → when eval/visual/shipcheck gates are on the judging path, rubric files come from base_ref trusted revision or digest-gate; (7) ownership_authority → CODEOWNERS / ownership|authority maps consulted for override/stage ownership load from base_ref or digest-gate.
On outcome=rebound for a class that feeds live acceptance, the run SHALL enforce that class’s CLASS_LIVE_ENFORCEMENT entry before ready-to-deploy.
Base-absent newly added sensitive files: trusted side is engine_default/absence; candidate bytes for those paths MUST NOT become sole live acceptance authority for the same run.

End-to-end / injectable fixtures MUST show a candidate-weakened policy, gate command/script, schema, rubric, or ownership rule cannot reach readiness unless the trusted rule governs acceptance — one fixture family per base_ref class minimum.

Mid-run effective verifier identity change (engine probe drift, re-computed decision hash change, or always-consulted surface digest change): (a) durable-write verifier_invalidation (or equivalent) with previous_hash, next_hash, stage, at, affected_evidence_families; (b) map changed classes to families — engine_core|engine_prompts|repo_policy → all readiness families on the path; gate_commands → tester and any enabled gate family whose command/script changed; eval_rubrics → eval/visual/shipcheck as enabled; evidence_schemas → families consuming those schemas; ownership_authority → review residual/override authority paths; (c) treat readiness evidence whose verifier_fingerprint binds the prior effective_verifier_hash as non-current; (d) allowsReadyToDeploy / finalize refuse ready-to-deploy while invalidation is open until replacement evidence is produced under the new identity (or the run blocks).
Fault-injection tests: generate readiness evidence under H1, alter effective verifier input, later stage must refuse readiness on H1-bound evidence.
evidence: Spec rebound scenario: readiness-relevant policy acceptance SHALL use trusted (base) policy surface.

Pre-revise gaps: ensureTrustedSurfaceDecision does not re-resolve cfg from base; resolveConfig reads worktree pipeline.yml; checkEngineDrift only warns; no class→loader map (challenges c9c63ccd, 16d2e94c).
Engine side already satisfies process binding via import.meta.url + template snapshot; modules_fingerprint added in d3.
decisions.generalization_boundary: Does not sandbox arbitrary subprocesses (#618). Does not move verification into Project Warrant. Operator-authorized evaluate-under-candidate mode remains out of scope for v1. Does not require re-executing already-imported JS without process restart when disk drifts — invalidation + refuse readiness is sufficient.
decisions.uncertainty: Medium on implementation mix per class (full base cfg reload vs targeted digest gate). Low that decision+fingerprint alone or warn-only drift is insufficient — those options are rejected.

assumptions: Some verifier surfaces are always loaded (engine pin; .github/pipeline.yml via resolveConfig when present).
Some classes are only on the judging path when gates/config enable them (e.g. eval rubrics when eval gate off).

invariants: Engine-defined ALWAYS_CONSULTED_VERIFIER_PATHS (v1 minimum): (a) installed engine pin fields used by hashEnginePin including modules_fingerprint; (b) .github/pipeline.yml and .github/pipeline.yaml at base_sha when the blob exists (repo_policy always-consulted paths for resolveConfig).

Engine-defined CONDITIONAL_CONSULT_RULES (v1): from trusted (base-resolved) policy — if test_gate enabled (default on): include test_gate.command string identity and any filesystem script path referenced by that command that matches gate_commands globs when resolvable as a repo path; if eval_gate/visual_gate/shipcheck_gate enabled: include that gate’s command identity, referenced scripts, and rubric paths matched by eval_rubrics that the gate/config declares or the engine loads for that family; evidence_schemas modules for each kind in resolveRequiredEvidenceKinds(gates); ownership_authority paths when the run consults override/stage ownership maps.

Touched base_ref paths continue to hash base blobs (or engineDefaultHash when all touched paths absent at base).

engineDefaultHash(classId) is allowed only for (1) true absence at base for that material, or (2) classes documented as not on this run’s judging path via CONDITIONAL_CONSULT_RULES (unused gate families) with an explicit not-on-path reason in the class record or design tests.
blocked outcomes set effective_verifier_hash null rather than a partial pin.

Tests MUST include a matrix: change base content of each ALWAYS_CONSULTED path and each CONDITIONAL path that is on-path for a fixture config, with candidate_paths product-only; each relevant change alters effective_verifier_hash or blocks.

decisions.uncertainty: Low on naming the inventory constants. Residual medium on auto-detected test commands that shell out without a single script path — those contribute command-string identity under trusted policy, not full argv expansion of every binary on PATH.
